title: Linux_Remaiten.C_Botnet_Investigation_f2a
description: Investigate and respond to the Linux/Remaiten.C botnet activity, focusing on identifying and mitigating the botnet's command and control (C2) communication and lateral movement capabilities.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential unauthorized access. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Host: victim (192.168.80.100)

- Password: ubuntu

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that is beaconing to an external server?
levels.solution: To identify the suspicious service, check running services and look for unusual network connections. The service name is `bot-beacon.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and look for unusual network connections.

levels.title: Identify Excessive Network Traffic Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service generating excessive network traffic?
levels.solution: Examine systemd timers and services for unusual activity. The service name is `bot-flood.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine systemd timers and services for unusual activity.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Investigate systemd timers and services for clues about how the service maintains persistence. The persistence mechanism is a systemd timer named `system-update-checker.timer`.
